text: Something just changed.
Claude writes the code now.
So anyone can ship it.
Mobile, desktop, headset: it's all an app, sold by subscription.
And everyone is shipping.
But shipping was the easy part.
The hard question is what it's worth.
Every calculator hands you a number, and keeps the reasoning.
So here is the reasoning.
You drag one dove across a plate, and a valuation happens.
Your revenue is a surface: price on one side, customers on the other.
Where that puts you has a name.
On the pricing ladder, Spotify is a mouse, at €2 a month.
Salesforce is a whale.
Everyone sits somewhere.
Your price per customer decides your trade.
Then direct costs, acquisition and fixed costs each take their share.
And nine lines build the multiple on what remains.
Building it was never the hard part.
Knowing what it's worth is.
Colombes. Free. No sign-up.
